facts.raw_span: A 40-year-old man presented with a painful nodule on the lower part of his right leg
the lesion had been stable in size and painless for 4 years but had enlarged and become tender over the past 6 months
an irregular, firm, erythematous, mobile, tender mass measuring 3.5 × 2.3 × 1.7 cm was noted just above the lateral malleolus of the right leg
No popliteal or inguinal lymphadenopathy was present
there were no other suspicious cutaneous lesions
Routine blood tests, including complete blood count, fasting blood sugar, liver and renal function tests, were within normal limits
Tests for hepatitis B surface antigen and HIV were negative
a lobulated, tan-gray, firm mass partly covered by skin, measuring 3.5 × 2.3 × 1.7 cm
nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma
Mitotic figures, including atypical forms, measured 7–8 per 10 high-power fields
Immunohistochemical staining showed strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45
The tumor cells were negative for S-100 protein, pancytokeratin, epithelial membrane antigen, and CD31

concepts.why: The presence of nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma, along with strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45, is consistent with dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.
The presence of atypical mitotic figures and a high mitotic rate, along with the absence of S-100 protein and other melanocytic markers, is consistent with atypical fibroxanthoma.

The presence of nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli, along with focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45, is consistent with malignant melanoma.
The presence of spindle-shaped cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei, along with a high mitotic rate, is consistent with leiomyosarcoma.
The presence of a pleomorphic tumor with spindle-shaped and epithelioid cells, along with a high mitotic rate, is consistent with pleomorphic undifferentiated sarcoma.
The presence of a tumor with spindle-shaped cells and a collagenous stroma, along with erythema and tenderness, is consistent with inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor.
The presence of a tumor with nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells, along with a collagenous stroma, is consistent with cellular neurothekeoma.
The presence of a tumor with spindle-shaped cells and a collagenous stroma, along with granular cytoplasm, is consistent with granular cell tumor.

rationales.F10: High mitotic activity is more typical of atypical fibroxanthoma and pleomorphic undifferentiated sarcoma.
rationales.F11: Strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45 are characteristic of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans and atypical fibroxanthoma.
rationales.F12: Negative staining for S-100 protein, pancytokeratin, epithelial membrane antigen, and CD31 helps to rule out malignant melanoma and other tumors.
